title: Regional Lead, Client Implementation
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Job Purpose The Implementation Lead is responsible for building, managing, and continuously improving a high-performing regional team of Implementation agents. This role drives the strategic execution of Moniebook's customer onboarding programme at scale, ensuring that every new retail customer in the region is successfully activated, trained, and transitioned into a confident, long-term user of the Moniebook solution. Operating at the intersection of people leadership, operational excellence, and customer success strategy, the Implementation Lead sets performance standards, develops team capability, removes escalation blockers, and partners cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Account Management to deliver a world-class onboarding experience. Success is measured by team-wide activation rates, time-to-value benchmarks, retention outcomes, and the quality of customer handoffs across the region measure success. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Performance Management Recruit, onboard, coach, and retain a regional team of Implementation Agents, fostering a culture of accountability, customer obsession, and continuous improvement. Set clear individual and team performance goals aligned to activation rates, time-to-value, feature adoption, CSAT scores, and churn reduction targets. Conduct regular 1:1s, team reviews, and performance evaluations; identify skill gaps and build development plans to close them. Onboarding Strategy & Programme Oversight Design scalable onboarding frameworks that allow the team to manage growing customer volumes without compromising on quality or personalisation. Define and maintain onboarding milestones, success metrics, and quality standards across all customer segments. Identify opportunities to streamline onboarding timelines and reduce time-to-value without sacrificing adoption depth. Escalation Management & Issue Resolution Act as the first point of escalation for complex technical issues, difficult customer situations, or onboarding stalls that agents are unable to resolve independently. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to drive resolution of systemic issues affecting onboarding outcomes across the region. Maintain clear escalation pathways and SLA standards, ensuring customers always feel supported and informed during issue resolution. Cross-functional Collaboration Partner closely with the Sales team to ensure smooth pre-to-post sale handoffs and that customer expectations are properly set before onboarding begins. Collaborate with Account Managers to refine the handoff process, ensuring agents provide complete, high-quality context that enables seamless long-term retention. Work with the Product team to surface recurring customer pain points, usability gaps, and feature adoption blockers, acting as a regional voice of the customer. Data, Reporting & Insights Track and analyse team-wide performance data including activation rates, onboarding completion timelines, feature adoption depth, CSAT scores, and early-stage churn metrics. Produce regular reports for senior leadership on regional onboarding health, trends, risks, and improvement initiatives. Use data to identify underperforming segments, agents, or onboarding touchpoints, and drive targeted interventions to address root causes. Process Improvement & Innovation Continuously review and refine onboarding processes, tools, and resources to improve efficiency, consistency, and customer outcomes. Champion the adoption of new technologies, automation, or methodologies that can enhance the team's ability to deliver high-touch onboarding at scale. Build a feedback loop between frontline agent insights and senior leadership/product decisions to ensure ground-level learnings influence the business. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Operations, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 4 - 6 years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or implementation roles, with at least 2–3 years in a team lead or people management capacity. Proven track record of leading onboarding or CS teams to consistently achieve activation, adoption, and retention targets, ideally within SaaS, retail technology, or fintech. Strong people leadership skills with the ability to motivate, develop, and hold a distributed team accountable for outcomes. Excellent analytical skills, able to interpret customer health data, team performance metrics, and identify actionable trends. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; able to present to senior leadership, navigate cross-functional relationships, and represent the customer voice persuasively. Deep customer empathy combined with a results-driven orientation. Highly organised with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and escalations simultaneously without compromising quality. Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments; brings structure and clarity without over-engineering. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or scaling onboarding teams from the ground up in a high-growth technology company. Exposure to retail operations, merchant services, or point-of-sale technology. Experience designing training curricula, onboarding playbooks, or knowledge management systems. Familiarity with customer health scoring methodologies, NPS/CSAT frameworks, or CS operations best practices. About You You are a natural leader who takes genuine pride in developing the people around you, and you measure your success by the success of your team and your customers. You are strategic and execution-focused; you can zoom out to design the right system and zoom in to resolve a customer escalation on the same day. You bring calm, clarity, and decisiveness under pressure. When things go wrong, your team looks to you and finds confidence, not panic. You are deeply data-literate; you use numbers to tell stories, make decisions, and hold yourself and your team accountable. You are a collaborative partner who builds trust across functions, Sales, Product, Support, and Account Management, and all see you as an ally, not a blocker. You thrive in environments where the playbook is still being written, and you take ownership of writing it. You are customer-obsessed at scale, even as you move further from direct customer interaction, you never lose sight of the human beings behind the metrics. What Success Looks Like Your regional team consistently achieves 90%+ customer activation rates within the 30–60 day onboarding window, month over month. Average time-to-live for customers in your region is at or below the 1–2 week target, with no systemic delays attributed to onboarding execution gaps. Regional post-onboarding CSAT scores average 4.5+, and your team's handoff quality is rated as excellent by Account Managers. Early-stage churn (within 90 days post-onboarding) for customers in your region remains below 5%. Your agents are among the most skilled and engaged at Moniebook, attrition on your team is low, development is visible, and performance is strong. You have documented, improved, and operationalised at least two significant enhancements to the regional onboarding playbook each quarter. What we can offer you Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning: We have a learning-and-development-focused environment, with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits. What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter. An interview with the operations lead. A behavioural and technical interview with the business lead. Moniepoint is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Senior Content Designer
description: About Us: Moniepoint Group is a financial technology company digitizing Africa’s real economy by building a financial ecosystem for businesses, providing them with all the payment, banking, credit and business management tools they need to succeed. At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community, dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We have several products that provide essential services for businesses such as credit, overdrafts, bank integration, payment gateway, etc. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to make our decisions, but also have the technology and data-driven best practices used to support our businesses. About this role: As a Senior Content Designer, you take ownership of the quality and strategic direction of content across your squad or product area. You bring expert content design judgment, deep user insight, and a collaborative mindset to shape product experiences that are clear, inclusive, and emotionally engaging. You support junior content designers, influence cross-team content strategy, and play a vital role in driving alignment across product, design, and engineering. You display an exceptional grasp of design thinking and content design expertise and are comfortable delivering well-thought out ideas to senior stakeholders and driving content design strategy each day.  What you’ll do  You are responsible for end-to-end content design strategy and execution on a project, from discovery through delivery, launch, and ongoing iteration. Partnering closely with product managers, product designers, and engineers to embed content strategy in product discovery and delivery, shaping scope, trade-offs, and sequencing. Define for exceptional, accessible, and inclusive content that builds trust, clarity, and meaningful user engagement. Comfortable wireframing and prototyping and delivering your work in Figma, with clear rationale, adhering to a design systems and content design principles. Define content design strategy that aligns with business objectives and technical feasibility, ensuring content is not just clear but emotionally intelligent and on brand. Craft high-quality content for complex product flows, interface text, microcopy, error messaging, help content, and documentation, setting the bar for tone, clarity, and consistency. Take a strong role in qualitative and quantitative research methods (user interviews, usability tests, A/B experiments, content audits, analytics) using insight as a core design input. Collaborate deeply, proactively shaping product direction, surfacing trade-offs, and influencing delivery approaches. Drive the evolution of content design style guides, working closely with brand, marketing, and communications teams. Design thoughtful content that enhances usability, emotional impact, and user satisfaction. Balance speed and rigour with strong judgment on when to ship versus polish, especially on complex or fast-moving environments. Support junior content designers on the team and supports in terms of stakeholder management.  Lead alignment and collaboration across teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating content design rationale and facilitating strategic working sessions. Set a high standard for product teams, fostering a culture of sound content design practices, constructive feedback, and shared accountability. You are able to justify content design decisions to senior stakeholders with clear rationale and delivers work in a standardised format that you help to evolve. You are able to deliver multiple variations, informed by insights and can confidently explain the pros and cons of particular solutions. What you need to succeed 5+ years of experience working as a content designer.  You are incredibly comfortable with the design aspect of content design – understanding this role is deeper than 'just words'. Strong stakeholder management skills are a must for this role.  You must be able to work in a fast-changing environment where processes are still being defined.  Exceptional knowledge of content design principles and end-to-end product thinking.  Experience with A/B testing, UX metrics, and data interpretation and the ability to drive your own research initiatives.  Exceptional product intuition - understanding user needs, business constraints, and technical feasibility. Good knowledge of Figma - how to collaborate, create prototypes, and work to produce agile solutions quickly, with little to no help.  Experience using AI a plus. Great if you’ve built workflows/tools using AI.  Excellent knowledge of working in cross-functional teams. Strategic Hiring Campaigns & Technical Enablement Targeted Campaign Architecture: Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines. Technical EVP Translation: Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors. Performance, Analytics & Optimization Hiring-Centric Metrics: Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill. Budget Oversight: Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver. Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever): Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration. 5. Strategic Leadership & Scalability Strategic Thought Partnership: Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment. Playbook Documentation: Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets. European Market Expertise: Demonstrated experience building talent brand presence and hiring pipelines across European tech ecosystems (particularly Central/Eastern Europe such as Poland, and Western/Southern Europe such as the UK or Spain). Zero-to-One Market Entry Track Record: Proven success entering new geographies or scaling talent brand where the employer brand was nascent or non-existent, creating playbooks from a blank sheet of paper. Fintech & Scale Exposure: Experience in hyper-growth fintech, high-frequency/payments infrastructure, or high-scale distributed systems environments. International Collaboration: Experience collaborating with international founding teams or distributed tech hubs across emerging and mature markets. Skills & Competencies Mastery in Event-Driven Pipeline Activation: Extensive hands-on experience designing and executing physical and digital developer events and architecting the subsequent candidate nurturing journey that yields hires. Deep Engineering Domain Fluency: Genuine understanding of software engineering culture, tech stacks (distributed systems, backend, infra, DevOps), and developer channels (Meetup, Eventbrite, GitLab/GitHub, Reddit, tech conferences). Comfort with Substantial Ambiguity: High agency and entrepreneurial drive; ability to make decisive bets, test hypotheses, and build structure in fast-moving, high-growth environments. Strategic Campaign Design: Ability to connect high-level EVP strategy to pragmatic, sprint-based talent acquisition sprints that deliver on an aggressive hiring plan (500+ tech hires). Launch targeted marketing sprints for top 3 hardest-to-fill senior technical roles. title: Team Lead, System Administrator
description: Who we are Moniepoint is an all-in-one financial services platform for emerging markets and the second-fastest-growing company in Africa. Since 2019, Moniepoint’s technology has powered over 3 million people, offering personal and business banking, payment, credit and business management tools to help them succeed. Moniepoint processed $182 billion in 2023, and currently processes the majority of the POS transactions in Nigeria.  Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the Role The Team Lead, Systems Administration, is a senior individual contributor who also leads the IT infrastructure team tactically. This role is responsible for both the hands-on delivery of complex systems work and the orchestration of team priorities, standards, and output quality. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in networking, cloud infrastructure, security, and automation with the leadership capability to coach a team, enforce SOPs, and drive measurable operational excellence, including leveraging AI tools to optimise how the team works. This role sits at the Team Lead level in Moniepoint's Talent Architecture. Success is defined not only by personal technical output, but by the team's consistent performance and delivery against infrastructure-wide targets. Scope & Decision Horizon Leads the IT infrastructure team tactically. Success is the orchestration of people and priorities to ensure the team's immediate output aligns with the broader roadmap. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Team Leadership & Operations Lead, coordinate, and coach a team of Systems Administrators, ensuring consistent output quality and adherence to SOPs. Manage team workload, prioritise tasks across competing demands, and ensure SLA compliance across all infrastructure functions. Conduct regular 1:1s, deliver direct and specific performance feedback, and actively develop team members' technical skills. Design and enforce team workflows and escalation paths, ensuring quality is consistent regardless of who executes the task. Own team-level metrics: system uptime (99.9%+), ticket SLAs, incident response times, and end-user satisfaction. Identify gaps in team capability or process and proactively close them through training, tooling, or workflow redesign. Infrastructure Management Design, implement, and maintain a robust IT infrastructure, including servers and virtualisation platforms (Proxmox). Administer and optimise Windows Server, Linux systems, and hybrid cloud infrastructures. Maintain comprehensive system documentation, network diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Plan and execute system upgrades with minimal downtime; optimise for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Cloud & Network Infrastructure Design, deploy, and manage cloud network environments across GCP, OCI, and Azure, Outpost, including VPCs, subnets, peering, firewall rules, and private connectivity. Administer and optimise BGP routing policies, virtual routers (vRTF), and F5 load balancers across the enterprise network and cloud environments. Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise networking infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points). Implement and maintain network security protocols, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation across on-premise and cloud environments. Manage DNS, DHCP, Directory as a Service, and other core network services. Monitor network performance, analyse bandwidth utilisation, and implement QoS policies. AI Tools & Workflow Automation Manage, maintain, and evaluate AI tools used across the IT and infrastructure function, ensuring reliability, access control, and appropriate use. Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n and similar platforms to optimise repetitive operational processes. Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for network deployment, incident triage, and infrastructure monitoring. Coach team members on responsible AI integration, when to use AI tools, how to validate outputs, and where human review is required. Identify opportunities to reduce manual toil through intelligent automation and continuously improve the team's automation capabilities. Telephony & Unified Communications Administer and maintain the xCALLY PBX platform, including call routing, IVR configuration, queue management, and agent provisioning. Troubleshoot telephony incidents end-to-end: SIP trunks, PBX dial plans, voice quality, and carrier integration. Coordinate with ISPs and telecom carriers to ensure uptime and quality of voice services across all sites. Automation & Scripting Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency. Utilise Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible) for consistent and scalable infrastructure deployment. Build and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, and Nagios. Document automation and tooling clearly enough for an Associate-level team member to execute independently. Security & Compliance Implement and enforce IT security policies, access controls, and data protection measures across on-premise and cloud environments. Manage endpoint security solutions, patch management, and privileged access management. Manage user authentication systems, including SSO, MFA, and identity governance. Lead incident response: manage security events, conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA), and implement permanent fixes. User Endpoint & Technical Support Oversee onboarding and offboarding procedures, ensuring seamless first-day experiences and complete account lifecycle management. Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, group management, Drive policies, and app integrations. Manage MDM solutions for corporate devices across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Provide or oversee expert-level L2/L3 support, ensuring timely resolution and minimal user disruption. Manage IT asset inventory, lifecycle, and procurement coordination. Qualifications, Competencies & Skills Education & Experience Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of proven experience in systems administration, infrastructure, or network engineering roles. At least 2 years of formal or informal team leadership, including coaching, delegation, and performance feedback. Relevant industry certifications (CompTIA, Cisco, Microsoft, GCP/Azure/OCI cloud, Linux) are highly desirable, but not compulsory. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Active Directory / Directory as a Service (e.g., JumpCloud); Linux/Unix administration (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian). Cloud networking expertise across GCP, OCI, and Azure: VPCs, subnets, load balancers, private service connect, VPN gateways, and cloud firewall management. Deep understanding of TCP/IP, BGP routing protocols, switching, VLANs, and enterprise network architecture across data centre and WAN environments. Hands-on experience with virtual routers (vRTF), F5 load balancers, and enterprise networking equipment (Cisco, Ubiquiti). Virtualisation experience with Proxmox; data centre operations including rack and stack, power, cooling, and structured cabling. Experience administering xCALLY PBX or equivalent enterprise telephony/unified communications platforms. Proficiency in scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash; experience with Ansible and Terraform. Hands-on experience with n8n or equivalent workflow automation platforms for building and managing operational automations. Experience managing AI tools within an IT environment, including access control, integration, and responsible use governance. Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, PRTG) and endpoint/MDM management platforms. Proficiency in Google Workspace administration: user and group management, Drive, Gmail, Meet, and third-party app integrations. Advanced infosec tooling experience (e.g., CrowdStrike); knowledge of Disaster Recovery protocols and DR drills. Experience with Jira Service Management; understanding of SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs.
